title: Claude Code Permissions: Stop Approving Every Command
description:
Tired of approving every AI command? Set the rules once. 🔒

✅ Open .claude/settings.json
✅ Allow safe commands like npm test
✅ Deny reading your .env file, and deny always wins

Day 1 of Safe AI Agents! Next up, Day 2: Keep Secrets Out of AI Context.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to lock down your AI coding agents.

#shorts #claudecode #aicoding #aiagents #aisecurity #ai #programming #coding
comment: Allow or Deny: which rule would you write first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: you can also share rules with your team by committing .claude/settings.json to your project.
